title: Enterprise zones including proposed Nāpili zone
summary: The council adopted Resolution 25-193, the enterprise zone resolution, on December 5 with seven ayes. The item had stalled in November, when a first vote on both resolutions tied four to four. The vice chair then said she would work with a council member to answer her questions and bring the enterprise zone item back.

timeline.text: The council adopted Resolution 25-193, the enterprise zone resolution, with seven ayes.
